summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Salada Soul online food ordering platform. All backend APIs (15/15) passing, frontend UI fully functional with excellent mobile responsiveness. Complete user flow working end-to-end including menu browsing, cart management, checkout, and admin management.

design_issues.issue: Minor React warnings about setState in render and missing aria-describedby for DialogContent

passed_tests: GET /api/categories - returns 4 categories (Saladas, Bowls, Sucos, Sobremesas)
GET /api/products - returns 9 products with correct fields
GET /api/products?category_id=X - filters products by category
POST /api/orders - creates order with items, returns order with id and order_number
GET /api/orders/{id} - returns order details
GET /api/orders/phone/{phone} - returns order history by phone
POST /api/orders/{id}/rate - submits rating
POST /api/auth/login - admin login with JWT token
GET /api/admin/orders - returns orders list (requires auth)
PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/status - updates order status
PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/payment - marks as paid
GET /api/admin/products - returns all products
POST /api/admin/products - creates new product
PUT /api/admin/products/{id} - updates product
Menu page loads with categories sidebar, product grid, and cart
Adding item to cart shows toast and updates cart count
Checkout page with delivery/pickup selection and form validation
Admin login page works with JWT auth
Admin orders dashboard loads with order cards and filtering
Admin products page shows product management with CRUD operations
Mobile responsiveness - all features work on mobile viewport
Complete end-to-end user flow from menu to checkout
Admin panel navigation and functionality
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix minor React console warnings in AdminLoginPage component (setState in render) and add aria-describedby to DialogContent for better accessibility. These are low-priority cosmetic issues.
